itens.trecho: Um bom filme, mas uma adaptação questionável do livro. Este filme é a adaptação cinematográfica de um dos livros mais famosos de C. S. Lewis, que escreveu a série de contos "Crónicas de Nárnia".

In my last review (which you can find on my Letterboxd), I said The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe was a "nearly perfect film." Well, I am here to say that with this viewing, to me, it is a perfect film. I used to always think this film was a sort of step below LOTR, and, while LOTR is indeed a masterpiece of cinema, I don't regard this film as lesser.

The feeling of discovering a secret universe where winter seems eternal awakens that sense of pure wonder we usually lose in the daily grind. Revisiting this story years later made me realize that magic doesn't age when it's treated with the respect it deserves.
